Nicea — Ayurveda prakaaram acne (mukku/face pimples) oorvalakku moolam Agni-in debilitation, athu especially Pitta dosha imbalance aagathaal nadakum. Symptoms-um treatment-um romba mukkiyam:

Symptoms (saaram)
- mukha, chest, back la pimples
- blackheads
- whiteheads / pustules
- red, swollen pimples with pus
- touch panna vedikkum pimples

Ayurvedic treatment (SreeSurya Ayurveda prakaaram)
- Pitta‑conciliating diet: Pitta kuraiya diet follow pannunga. Oily, spicy, sour and fermented foods avoid pannunga (idhu continuing breakouts irundha romba important).
- Internal medicines: Pitta um ama-um shaman panna ullatra internal medications.
- Diet & lifestyle modifications: daily routine, food choices, stress control bage changes.
- Therapeutic treatments: topical lepanam (herbal pastes), swedanam (steam therapy) madiri procedures.

Personalized plan venumna, namma clinic‑la consultation panni ungala pathi detailed diet, medicine and therapy plan prescribe pannuvom. Appointment venuma?
